title.en: Chapter 15 — The Man of the Island

sentences.ar: وقفت مكاني، وما عرفت أركض لوين.
sentences.en: I stopped where I was, and did not know which way to run.
Behind me the murderers, and before me this thing.

sentences.ar: وبعدين طلع من ورا الشجرة، ونزل على ركبه، ومد إيديه.
sentences.en: And then it came out from behind the tree, and dropped to its knees, and held out its hands.
It was a man.

sentences.ar: شعره طويل وأسود، وجلده محروق من الشمس.
sentences.en: His hair was long and black, his skin burned by the sun.
And his clothes were rags tied together.

sentences.ar: وعيونه بتلمع، زي واحد ما شاف بني آدم من سنين.
sentences.en: And his eyes shone, like someone who had not seen a human being in years.
He said: who are you?
I said: Jim.
He said: Jim, Jim.
I am Ben Gunn.
I am poor Ben Gunn.

sentences.ar: صار لي تلات سنين ما حكيت مع حدا.
sentences.en: It has been three years since I spoke with anyone.
I said: three years?
Was your ship wrecked?
He said: no.
They left me here.
That is what they do with a traitor.
And he talked about cheese.
He said: do you dream of cheese?
I dream of it every night.
And then he asked me: is that Flint's ship?
I said: Flint is dead.
But his men are with us on the ship.
He said: is there one with one leg?
I said: Silver.

sentences.ar: ارتجف بن غن كله، ومسك إيدي.
sentences.en: Ben Gunn shook all over, and grabbed my hand.

sentences.ar: قال: إذا سيلفر بعتك، أنا ميت.
sentences.en: He said: if Silver sent you, I am dead.

sentences.ar: بس إنت مش من رجاله، صح؟
sentences.en: But you are not one of his men, right?
And I told him the whole story.

sentences.ar: سمع، وبعدين ضحك، وقال: أنا كنت مع فلينت لما دفن الكنز.
sentences.en: He listened, and then laughed, and said: I was with Flint when he buried the treasure.

sentences.ar: قال: كنت بسفينة تانية، ورجعت أدور على الكنز مع رجالي.
sentences.en: He said: I was on another ship, and came back to look for the treasure with my men.
Twelve days we searched, and did not find.
So they turned on me, and left me.

sentences.ar: بس أنا بن غن، وأنا ذكي.
sentences.en: But I am Ben Gunn, and I am clever.

sentences.ar: وغمز لي، وقال: روح قول للسكوير: بن غن بده يرجع على بيته.
sentences.en: And he winked at me, and said: go and tell the squire: Ben Gunn wants to go home.

sentences.ar: وبده حصة، وعنده مركب زغير عمله بإيده، تحت الصخرة البيضا.
sentences.en: And he wants a share, and he has a little boat he made with his own hands, under the white rock.

sentences.ar: وبهاللحظة، سمعنا صوت مدفع من السفينة.
sentences.en: And in that moment, we heard a cannon from the ship.
Ben Gunn said: the war has begun.
